WITH locked AS (
                    SELECT id FROM refresh_token_families
                    WHERE user_id = $1
                    AND ($2::TEXT IS NULL OR client_id = $2)
                    AND revoked_at IS NULL
                    ORDER BY id
                    FOR UPDATE
                )
                UPDATE refresh_token_families f
                SET revoked_at = now()
                FROM locked
                WHERE f.id = locked.id AND f.revoked_at IS NULL
